title: Half switching bound
statement: For every Boolean function $f$ on $N$ bits and every positive integer $w$, suppose $f$ has a disjunctive normal form or a conjunctive normal form of width at most $w$. Then, for every nonnegative integer $k$, the probability that $f$ fails under switching at rate determined by $w$ is at most $2^{-k}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $N$ bits
$f$ has DNF width at most $w$ or CNF width at most $w$
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the switching rate or switching failure probability, so their precise meanings cannot be made self-contained here.
